## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `e2cc08eb5248d78f6cd6f6b8841a11ab54220aaf`
Local-runs: none
Scope: docs/adr/0146-studio-designs-setup-administers-one-editor-per-item-paired-customize-package.md + packages/spec/src/kernel/customization-package.ts, packages/spec/src/kernel/manifest.zod.ts (MANIFEST_ID_PATTERN, PluginEnginesSchema), packages/spec/src/kernel/protocol-version.ts, packages/spec/src/kernel/namespace-prefix.ts, packages/spec/src/kernel/platform-capabilities.ts, packages/spec/src/system/constants/platform-object-names.ts, packages/spec/src/kernel/package-registry.zod.ts, packages/metadata-core/src/protocol-handshake.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-customization-package.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-packaged-base-refusal.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-package-install.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/package-writability.ts, packages/objectql/src/registry.ts (coOwnersOf, isShareableNamespace, assertPackageUninstallable), packages/runtime/src/runtime-version.ts, .changeset/config.json, packages/runtime/package.json, scripts/adr-index.mjs, docs/adr/README.md, docs/adr/0019-app-as-consumer-unit.md, docs/adr/0130-release-artifact-as-co-ownership-boundary.md, docs/adr/0141-inter-app-dependency-declared-checked-before-install.md; objectstack-ai/hotcrm 6961ab1 src/{sales,service,revenue,marketing,o2c}/index.ts; PR #31026 (first consumer, pairOf/appOf). Cited code read, never reviewed; the diff has no remainder (one file).

Inputs: card #31014 body and both comments (claim 6691185615, os-dev-report 6692464232); PR #31027 body, file list (1 file, +133/−28) and the net diff against merge base 33bc8ae5 (= origin/main 7d9f1e97 for every cited file: zero drift); rulings 6691022506 and 6691217245 on #29594 read in full; check-runs on the head: every non-skipped run completed `success` at 2026-11-06T18:45Z (Lint · docs & code guards carries check:adr-index; Lint · repo & tooling gates carries check:pm-governed-prose; Governed Surface Queue Guard, Check Changeset, Check Documentation Links, Test Core 1/8 all green). PR author `objectstack-fleet[bot]`; draft; labels documentation, size/m, skip-changeset; no reviewer requested yet (the seat sets os-zhuang at hand-over, as the report says).

### ① Derived judgments

- **Accept set / public surface: none moves.** The diff is one ADR file; no `packages/spec` key, route, error code or export changes. `com.objectstack.kernel.custom` is a declared id in prose, not a constant in the tree. Right.
- **Status line** (line 27 on the head): one dated `· **Amended in place** (2026-11-06, ruling record … on #29594, maintainer, verbatim: 「① 定制单位 = App；同意」, and the second ruling record … verbatim: 「内核白名单…其他同意。」): … It lands by the maintainer's hand-merge of the PR cut from #31014.` Same shape as the 2026-10-31 (#28390) and 2026-11-06 (#30881) sentences: dated, ruling record linked, maintainer's words verbatim and untranslated, the moved clauses listed, the landing act named. House form holds. Right.
- **D3 heading and the "unit is the App" block**: one pair per App `app.objectstack.hotcrm.custom`; a module never owns a pair; the ensure door answers 201 then 200 and never 422 for a package of the same App; 422 NAMESPACE_CONFLICT stays for a namespace held outside the artifact (`coOwnersOf` arms unchanged — read: artifact, parent-dependency and sibling arms at registry.ts:8716-8740, untouched). Matches ruling ① word for word. HotCRM measured at hotcrm 6961ab1: `src/sales/index.ts` id `app.objectstack.hotcrm` type `app`; service/revenue/marketing/o2c ids `app.objectstack.hotcrm.*` type `module`; all `namespace: 'crm'`, all `6.1.0`. Four modules is the measured truth (the card's "three" predates hotcrm #2413). Right.
- **Namespace bullet**: `crm_custom` via `customizationNamespace('crm')` (grammar 20 chars, suffix 7, ok); `deriveNamespaceFromPackageId('app.objectstack.hotcrm.custom')` answers `custom` and is never written — read at namespace-prefix.ts:54-63. The `sys_` sentence cites `validateObjectNamespacePrefix`, whose line 33 is today's pass-through (`if (objectName.startsWith('sys_')) return null;`); the ADR says the ruling closes it. Right as a recorded decision, and the ruling's Workload gives the `sys_` gap to domain:spec.
- **Dependency range**: `^6` for HotCRM by `customizationDependencyRange('6.1.0')`; read at install by `assertDeclaredDependencies` (protocol-package-install.ts:334) through `checkDeclaredDependencies`. Right.
- **Platform suite paragraph**: kernel = manifest `scope` `system` or `cloud` (`READ_ONLY_PACKAGE_SCOPES` at package-writability.ts:38, exactly those two). 109-package `fixed` group verified in `.changeset/config.json`; `@objectstack/runtime` at 18.3.0; `PROTOCOL_VERSION` 18.0.0, lockstep by the docblock's own test. Orphan tolerance states ruling ② as recorded (goal vs fact, `PLATFORM_ALWAYS_ON_CAPABILITIES` at platform-capabilities.ts:350). Ruling ③ recorded as "no kernel object customizable in this version; next version Users and Organizations only, with the two prerequisites". Right — with the ④ should-fix on the second prerequisite's anchor.
- **Not taken (a)(c)(e)**, ADR-0019 and ADR-0130 not amended: read ADR-0019 D1–D4 (App the only consumer unit; module/plugin invisible and not consumer-installable; suites fold into one App; an App owns a namespace set and uninstalls atomically over it) and ADR-0130 D1/D6 (artifact = co-ownership proof; one artifact one version, a module on its own cadence becomes its own artifact). Nothing in the amendment contradicts them: one pair per App IS ADR-0019 D1–D3 applied to customization; the pair's range on the App's version is ADR-0130 D6's "one version"; the pair's `crm_custom` is outside the App's namespace set so ADR-0019 D4's atomic uninstall is not reached while the pair exists (the refusal fires first). Right.
- **Q4 row, Consequences "Cost, stated", D11 migration sentence, Decided-here 8/9/10, Refs**: each follows the new unit; the remaining `hotcrm.custom` mentions are covered by the new shorthand bullet. The residual "per base" wording at head lines 613 and 783 (the migration "reports per base") is correct under the shorthand (base = App or the platform pair). Right.
- **docs/adr/README.md unchanged — right.** `STATUS_LINE` (`/^\*\*Status\*\*:[ \t]*(.*)$/`) captures line 3 only; the inserted line 27 opens with `· **Amended in place** (` which `headerFields`' regex (`**Key**:` / `**Key:**`, optional leading `-`) does not match, so it is neither a field nor a status value; the row's date is the status value's first ISO date (2026-10-31, unchanged). The check-run "ADR index is current" is green on the head.
- **Header window — right.** `HEADER_WINDOW = 40`; `lines.slice(0, 40)` reads lines 1–40. The one inserted line moved `**Supersedes in part**:` from 38 to 39 and `**Amends**:` to 40; only `supersedes`/`superseded by`/date keys are read, so nothing the index reads left the window and the dev's "one line of headroom" is exact. The dev's declared observation (a three-line sentence would have dropped the column) is correct and worth the note it got.

### ② Semver level

Docs only (`docs/adr/**`), `skip-changeset` label, PR body `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`. Nothing publishes; Check Changeset green. Right.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **open_question 1 (pair id, A keep `com.objectstack.kernel.custom`)** — answered A. Verified against the tree: matches `MANIFEST_ID_PATTERN` (`/^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*(\.[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*)+$/`); `git grep -E 'com\.objectstack\.kernel\b'` → 0 hits on origin/main 7d9f1e97 and on hotcrm 6961ab1; `customizationBasePackageId` is the pure inverse (customization-package.ts:106-111) so it answers `com.objectstack.kernel`; `customizationNamespace('sys')` → `sys_custom`, 10 chars. `com.objectstack.platform` with the `'…'`-bounded grep is in 22 test files at 33bc8ae5 as the dev says; the fixture-collision argument holds (per-package pair and platform pair would coincide there). Keep A.
- **open_question 2 (engines.platform, A)** — answered A with a precision should-fix (④ S2): `resolveDeclaredRange` reads `engines.protocol` first and `engines.platform` only when protocol is absent (protocol-handshake.ts:246-256); `assertProtocolCompat` does run at `installPackage` (protocol-package-install.ts:325), so the declaration is judged at install — provided the pair's manifest carries no `engines.protocol`. `checkDeclaredDependencies` would indeed answer `absent` for a dependency on `com.objectstack.kernel` (protocol-handshake.ts:879-882). No ADR-0141 D2 amendment needed.
- **open_question 3 (kernel rows stay open, A)** — answered A. `packagelessOverlayWriteRefusal` closes a write only where `os migrate packageless-overlays` could move the row (protocol-packaged-base-refusal.ts:237-247), and `customizationPairEnsureRefusal`'s docblock states that the close leaves the write open where the door refuses (protocol-customization-package.ts:292-301); D8 item 1 keeps the package-less row winning until migrated. Closing with no pair to name would break D11's own "the sentence's two doors are always open". A is right. Note for the server lane (not a finding here): today's door does not refuse the FIRST kernel package asked — it would create `com.objectstack.audit.custom` and only the second answers 422 — so the kernel refusal of ruling ③ has to land in `customizationPairEnsureRefusal` before or with the migration, or the ceremony would move a kernel row into a per-package pair.
- **Deviation: `resolveRuntimeVersion()` is not the range's source** — right: runtime-version.ts:80 prefers `OS_RUNTIME_VERSION` (image tag / sha) over the package version. The ADR's "release version the fixed group ships" is the correct reading.
- **Deviation: four modules, not three** — verified, see ①.
- **Deviation: README byte-identical** — right, see ①.
- **Deviation: commit author spelled `objectstack-fleet[bot]`** — outside the hits file; the squash replaces it. Declared, accepted.
- **Deviation: MCP writes skipped / reviewer set at hand-over** — process; the PR has no requested reviewer yet, the seat owes `os-zhuang`.
- **Acceptance note: `cloud` scope binds nothing here** — verified: no `scope: 'cloud'` manifest under `packages/**` on origin/main (only CHANGELOG prose).
- **out_of_scope: code spelling untouched** — by the card's order; the first consumer is #31026 (pairOf/appOf, identity today, `packages/metadata-core/src/customization-pair-lookup.ts`), which cites the ruling and does not wait on this text. Right.
- **out_of_scope: header-window observation** — judged right in ①; noted, not filed, is the correct disposition.
- No `security_findings`; author is the relay bot, no off-relay login note owed.

### ④ Design judgment

`hits`: docs/adr/0146-…md, judged against the rulings, the cited code on origin/main (zero drift from the merge base), ADR-0019/0130/0141, the first consumer (#31026) and the execution plan (ruling 6691022506's Workload: ensure door by App, `customizable` verdict, orphan-tolerant platform pair; ruling 6691217245: whitelist next version).

**Decided here 8 — the platform pair id. Holds.** Constraints of the card's Expected 3 all verified (③ above). The id names the suite in the family every kernel id uses, is held by nothing, inverts cleanly, and the alternatives are weighed on evidence that checks out. No finding.

**Decided here 9 — the range in `engines.platform`. Holds, one precision gap (S2).** The install door runs `assertProtocolCompat(manifest)` before the registry write and the handshake compares the declared range to `PROTOCOL_MAJOR` (18), lockstep with the platform major; `^18` is therefore judged at install and re-install of the pair. `manifest.dependencies` cannot carry it: nothing holds `com.objectstack.kernel`, so `checkDeclaredDependencies` answers `absent`. The reversible middle (`^major`) matches merge question 1.
- **S2 (should-fix)**: `resolveDeclaredRange` prefers `engines.protocol`; a pair manifest that carries both keys has its platform range declared and never read. The ADR should say the platform pair declares `engines.platform` as its only `engines` key (or that `engines.protocol` is not written on it), so the server lane does not stamp the scaffold's `engines.protocol` beside it. In the same breath it may note that `customizationPairEnsureRefusal`'s existing-pair check today demands "a dependency on the base in manifest.dependencies" (protocol-customization-package.ts:334-335) and must read `engines.platform` for the platform pair — implementation, but the one place the ADR's rule and today's gate disagree.

**Decided here 10 — kernel overlay rows wait. Holds.** The mechanism is already the tree's: the close and the ceremony share one subject reading, and a refused ensure leaves the write open; D8 item 1 serves the row meanwhile. The ADR's reason (an administrator must still be able to edit an existing kernel view or template) is the right one. No finding.

**D3's remaining bullets under an App unit.**
- *Walled postures*: unchanged, posture-level, unit-independent. Holds.
- *Uninstall refusal*: `assertPackageUninstallable(packageId)` derives the pair of the id being uninstalled (registry.ts:7311-7313) and names it in `PackageUninstallExtendedError` with the export door; after #31026 that derivation is `pairOf(id)`, so uninstalling the App names `app.objectstack.hotcrm.custom`, and an attempt to uninstall one module by id would be refused naming the same pair — consistent with ADR-0019 D4 (uninstall is atomic over the App) and with the amendment's "a module a later version no longer delivers: overrides kept and marked, nothing refused". Holds.
- *It receives*: "from the Studio surface of the App or of any of its modules" — holds; the per-package customization read (N-15, D8 item 4) still answers per base, which the shorthand bullet maps to the App's pair filtered by the overridden package.
- *Readable `customizable` verdict* (ruling (b)): one sentence, as the card asked. Holds.

**Trying to break the unit — four should-fixes, no must-fix.**

- **S1 (should-fix) — the second next-version prerequisite misreads its anchor.** D3 says the `sys_` heuristics "are replaced by a declared reading (`isSystem`, `packages/spec/src/system/constants/platform-object-names.ts#hasPlatformObjectPrefix`), so a customer's `sys_custom_<short>` object inherits none of them". On origin/main `PLATFORM_OBJECT_PREFIXES = ['sys_', 'cloud_', 'ai_']` and `hasPlatformObjectPrefix(name)` is `startsWith` over that list (lines 187-201), whose own docblock calls it "the OLD heuristic"; `hasPlatformObjectPrefix('sys_custom_x')` answers `true`. No object-level `isSystem` declaration exists in `packages/spec` today (the only `isSystem` keys are the flow/AI service-context flags). So the sentence's consequence holds for a declared `isSystem` reading and is false for the anchored symbol. The ruling's wording ("isSystem / hasPlatformObjectPrefix()") was copied; the ADR, as the next card's Governing text, should name the declared reading as the thing to add and drop (or explicitly retire) the `hasPlatformObjectPrefix` anchor for the `sys_custom_` case. Not a must-fix: it binds the next version, not step 1, and no step-1 consumer reads it.
- **S3 (should-fix) — no disposition for a pair created under the old unit.** D3 has been in force since 2026-10-31 and the ensure door (#28407) is landed: an environment may already hold `app.objectstack.hotcrm.service.custom` (a module's pair) or `com.objectstack.<first kernel package>.custom` (the one pair today's door creates before the 422s of #29594). After the change `isPairOf('….service.custom', '….service')` is false, so that package's declared overrides fall under D2 Q1 / D8 item 2 ("no place under this record") and nothing in the amendment names a ceremony that folds them into the App's pair or says they are refused/kept. One sentence in D11 (or Decided-here 11): a pre-amendment per-package pair is moved into the App's pair by the migration ceremony, or is served until moved — the same discipline D11 applies to package-less rows. The dev's rehearsal plan (`dev:crm`) is exactly where this bites.
- **S4 (should-fix) — the App of a package is not readable from the tree, and the artifact-less package has no rule.** The amendment (and the ruling) define the App as "the `type: 'app'` package and the packages its artifact delivers". On origin/main nothing persists artifact membership: `InstalledPackageSourceSchema` is `code | marketplace | authored` (package-registry.zod.ts:67-71), the registry's artifact scope (`scope?.packageIds`, registry.ts:8722) is an install-time argument, and a code-booted App (HotCRM under `dev:crm`, every kernel package) has no artifact at all. The first consumer's `appOf` is the identity with "the seam the ruling moves" and no declared source. So the ensure door cannot, from the tree as cited, answer "which App delivers `app.objectstack.hotcrm.service`" — by id prefix? by the `defineStack` grouping? by a persisted artifact id? — and the ADR does not say, nor does it list the question under "Decided here where the rulings were silent". The same silence covers a package no App artifact delivers: ADR-0141 D3's standalone module, an operator-provisioned internal contribution (ADR-0019 D2), a `type: 'plugin'` installed alone — "a module never owns a pair" and "every installed App gets one pair" leave it either uncustomizable or its own unit, and #31026's tests treat an "independent package" as its own App. Add a Decided-here item naming the membership reading the ensure door uses (or explicitly delegating it to the server lane's card) and the rule for the artifact-less package. Nit folded in: the ADR names only `module` and `plugin` as delivered types; ADR-0019 D2's internal list (driver, server, ui, theme, agent, objectql, adapter) can also travel in an artifact — "every package its artifact delivers" is the safer phrase. Should-fix, not must-fix: the unit decision itself is the maintainer's and holds against ADR-0019/0130; what is missing is the ADR's own convention of recording the silent point, and the server lane's ensure-door PR (which cites this text) can carry the delta before it lands.

**Status line, index, window**: judged right in ①.

**Verdict reasoning.** Every ruled item (①, ②'s constraint, ③, (b), not-taken a/c/e, Q4, D11, the sys_ close) is recorded faithfully; the three "decided here" items hold against the live doors; ADR-0019 D1–D4 and ADR-0130 D1/D6 are not contradicted; the README and header-window claims are exact; every check-run on the head is green. The four should-fixes are precision and silence gaps the delta can carry; none makes the design wrong against the code it cites.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-kouhp1`
Reviewed-by: `session_01L9qibzzqHZdAVqgBAvxXKB`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `05ea9bbb78a26360c924e342f34357c1a2aa4a01`
Local-runs: none
Scope: docs/adr/0146-studio-designs-setup-administers-one-editor-per-item-paired-customize-package.md + packages/objectql/src/registry.ts (coOwnersOf, isShareableNamespace, ArtifactInstallScope, the install-time namespace gate), packages/core/src/artifact-packages.ts (declaredDependencyIds), packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-customization-package.ts (customizationPairEnsureRefusal), packages/metadata-core/src/protocol-handshake.ts (resolveDeclaredRange), packages/spec/src/system/constants/platform-object-names.ts, packages/spec/src/kernel/package-registry.zod.ts, packages/apps/{account,setup,studio}/src/index.ts, scripts/adr-index.mjs; objectstack-ai/hotcrm 6961ab1 src/{sales,service,revenue,marketing,o2c}/index.ts; PR #31026. Delta review of the round-1 record on e2cc08eb5248d78f6cd6f6b8841a11ab54220aaf (the template has no Delta-of line, so it is stated here): one commit 05ea9bbb on e2cc08eb, one file, +56/−12 (whole PR against merge base 33bc8ae5: +178/−29). Every cited file has zero drift between the merge base and origin/main 41dc3024.

Inputs: the delta diff; the rewritten PR body (adds "Contract review round 1" and Decided-here 11–12); card #31014 unchanged; check-runs on 05ea9bbb at 2026-11-06T19:10Z: every completed non-skipped run `success`, including the two docs jobs — Lint · docs & code guards (carries check:adr-index and check:adr-symbol-anchors) and Lint · repo & tooling gates (carries check:pm-governed-prose) — plus Lint · ESLint, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Check Documentation Links, Check PR Size, PR-body guards, Dogfood Regression Gate, Test UI, Type Check · workspace/source gates/debt ledger, the three Lint · scoped jobs, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Plan Test Core shards, Auto Label, filter. Still `in_progress`, none reading `docs/adr/**`: Lint · CI release & engine gates, Test Core 1/8, Type Check · consumer gates. No red.

### ① Derived judgments

- No accept-set or public-surface change (ADR prose only). Right.
- **Status line**: still one line (line 27), now ending "merge questions 8 to 12; the App of a package is read from the declarations the registry holds, a package that declares no App is its own unit, and a pair created under the old per-package unit is folded into its App's pair by the migration ceremony (merge questions 11 and 12)". House form kept. Right.
- **Header window still holds**: `**Status**:` line 3, `**Decided by**:` 28, `**Supersedes in part**:` 39, `**Amends**:` 40, `**Builds on**:` 41 — identical to the round-1 head; the delta added no header line. `HEADER_WINDOW` 40 reads lines 1–40; the one read field (Supersedes) sits at 39. Right.
- **README byte-identical**: the same reasoning as round 1 (STATUS_LINE captures line 3 only; the lengthened line 27 matches no header-field regex). Right; Lint · docs & code guards (check:adr-index) is green on this head.
- **"every package its artifact delivers, whatever its type"** replaces "module and plugin" (S4 nit). Right.
- **D3 item 9 bullet, D3 prerequisite sentence, D11 migrate bullet, Decided-here 11 and 12**: judged in ④.

### ② Semver level

Unchanged: docs only, `skip-changeset`, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`. Right.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Round-1 S1–S4 each claimed fixed in one commit: S1 fixed, S2 fixed, S3 partially fixed, S4 fixed with one edge (④).
- Dev notes the round-1 commit carries the checkout's configured author (the e2cc08eb author deviation stands, declared). Fine.
- The dev counts 14 `path#symbol` anchors now; `registry.ts#ArtifactInstallScope` resolves (registry.ts:3095 `export interface ArtifactInstallScope`), `package-registry.zod.ts#InstalledPackageSourceSchema` resolves (line 67). The symbol-anchor gate (Lint · docs & code guards) is green on this head.
- No new open_questions; no new deviations beyond the above.

### ④ Design judgment

**S1 — fixed.** The prerequisite now names "an object-level `isSystem` the next version adds to the object schema, which no spec key carries today" as the declared reading, and marks `hasPlatformObjectPrefix` ⛔ as "the old `startsWith` heuristic over `sys_`, `cloud_` and `ai_`, which answers true for `sys_custom_<short>` and is one of the heuristics to retire". Exactly what platform-object-names.ts:187-201 says. Holds.

**S2 — fixed.** "The platform pair's manifest carries `engines.platform` as its only `engines` key — no `engines.protocol`, which the install handshake reads first — and the ensure door reads that key, not `manifest.dependencies`, when it checks an existing platform pair." Matches `resolveDeclaredRange`'s order and names the one place today's `customizationPairEnsureRefusal` (`declaredRangeOn` over `manifest.dependencies`, lines 334-335) must gain an arm. With no `engines.protocol`, `assertProtocolCompat` at install judges `^18` against `PROTOCOL_MAJOR` 18. Holds.

**S4 — Decided-here 11. Fixed; tried to break it, one edge remains (should-fix S4b).**
- *The reading against the tree.* `declaredDependencyIds(manifest)` is `Object.keys(manifest.dependencies)` (packages/core/src/artifact-packages.ts:196-200), and `coOwnersOf`'s dependency arm filters those ids by `holdsNamespace` (registry.ts:8727-8731) — the ADR's "the one that holds its namespace where it declares several" is that filter, and the type test (`getPackage(id)?.manifest?.type === 'app'`) reads the same installed record. Code-booted packages reach the registry through `installPackage` with their manifest (the ensure door already reads `base.manifest.version` of a `dev:crm` package), so the declaration is readable at the ensure door with no new persistence. Holds.
- *HotCRM's manifests at 6961ab1.* The modules DO declare the App: `src/service/index.ts:197`, `src/revenue/index.ts:101`, `src/marketing/index.ts:75`, `src/o2c/index.ts:36`, each `dependencies: { 'app.objectstack.hotcrm': '^6.1.0' }`; `src/sales/index.ts:94` is `type: 'app'` and declares nothing. The sales docblock (line 22) states ADR-0019's "exactly one `type: 'app'` package per artifact", and line 143 that "`dependencies` is the edge". Each module declares exactly one app and it holds `crm`, so `appOf` answers `app.objectstack.hotcrm` for all four and the App for itself. Holds.
- *"Never an id prefix"* — right: `com.objectstack.*` kernel ids share a prefix with nothing that is an App, and HotCRM's `app.objectstack.hotcrm.*` would have given the same answer by accident; declaring the edge is the registry's own discipline.
- *"A type:'app' package is its own App"* — an App declaring another App (ADR-0141 D1) stays its own unit, consistent with ADR-0141. The platform's own `type: 'app'`-looking surfaces (account, setup, studio under `packages/apps/*`) are `type: 'plugin'`, `scope: 'system'`, so the kernel reading ("a kernel package is never such a unit") meets no system-scoped `type: 'app'` today; D3's platform-suite paragraph already states the kernel as the exception to "everything above". Holds.
- *ADR-0141 D3's standalone module*: member for customization, App for install/open/uninstall; uninstalling it alone keeps and marks its overrides. Consistent with the orphan sentence and with `assertPackageUninstallable` (after #31026, `pairOf(module)` names the App's pair). A third-party module with its own namespace that declares one App is also a member under this reading (its overrides land in the vendor App's pair); that is a consequence the ADR accepts, not a break.
- **S4b (should-fix) — a member that declares only members.** Item 11 reads *direct* declarations only (mirroring `coOwnersOf`: "Direct declarations only, never the closure"). A `crm` package delivered by the HotCRM artifact that declares only `app.objectstack.hotcrm.revenue` and not the App (a nested module) declares no `type: 'app'` package, so item 11 makes it "its own unit: `<its id>.custom` with `crm_custom`" — and the ensure door then answers `422 NAMESPACE_CONFLICT` (protocol-customization-package.ts:352-358: `crm_custom` owned by the App's pair), contradicting "never `422` for a package of the same App", while at install the artifact arm admitted it silently. HotCRM has no such module today, so this is narrow. One sentence: a package whose declared parents are members of one App is a member of that App (the one step `coOwnersOf`'s sibling arm already takes), or the readable verdict — never `422` for a package in a namespace an App's member holds.

**S3 — Decided-here 12 and the D11 sentence. Partially fixed (should-fix S3b).** The decision (fold into the App's pair; served as it is until moved; kernel ones wait with the kernel rows; never refuse or delete customer work) is right and complete as a disposition.
